summary: 1–3, John the Beloved will live until the Lord comes; 4–8, Peter, James, and John hold gospel keys.
meta_description: Revelation given to Joseph Smith the Prophet and Oliver Cowdery, at Harmony, Pennsylvania, April 1829, when they inquired through the Urim and Thummim as to whether John, the beloved disciple, tarried in the flesh or had died. The revelation is a translated version of the record made on parchment by John and hidden up by himself.
